**V4 content review SUSPENDED — adoption/application HOLD.** [Author suspension](https://github.com/Unjuno/agent-interface/pull/7148#issuecomment-5973813117) supersedes the earlier content-review offer5973402310. Do not approve, adopt or apply this head from the previous inert regressions alone; a repaired fixed proposal and its qualification are required.

Explicit key/button UP and wheel cleanup could retire custody before release was verified. This candidate retains custody, blocks dispatch during recovery and adds bounded XI2 readback for owned side buttons8/9. The workflow/native-harness selectors add the nine-method side-button module while preserving existing ordering.

The exact V4 source passes57 selected methods normally and with Python -O,176 endpoint rows, preserving141 previous endpoints and48 methods. Unrepaired source has10 assertion failures across nine methods; wrong-index source has3. Full source/commit/tree/parent/ref and saved/public evidence were verified. These original results remain unchanged and have their original inert scope.

New source-supported constructions expose missing qualification. Core XTEST may route UP to a different ClientPointer; current/pre/post identity observations can falsely clear custody after reassignment or ABA. A valid XI2 inventory can suppress unreadable button state to zero: unchanged V4 then reports completed/verified and clears custody while modeled button9 remains down. The access profile and stubborn release are explicit inert conditions, not an observed native XACE configuration or physical-effect claim. A separate property-transport construction error was retained and repaired in a marker-only run; original other cases were not rerun.

Standard explicit-device XI1 XTEST encoding avoids ClientPointer branch selection for a stable ID, but seven-bit bounds, ID reuse, source association and competing-client ownership remain. XI1 XQueryDeviceState also suppresses denied reads; the immutable XTEST marker identifies a subsystem rather than a unique generation. C/server/native effects were not executed or qualified.

[Continuations33/34 evidence part1](https://github.com/Unjuno/agent-interface/pull/7148#issuecomment-5973818443) and [part2](https://github.com/Unjuno/agent-interface/pull/7148#issuecomment-5973821630) recover71 projected full members with16 explicit reference/seal omissions; actual GET bodies and all member hashes verified. Original/private hashes and path projection are distinguished; exact omitted primary sources/dependencies are needed for full source-reader replay. First failures and three copied negative controls per construction are retained. Historical V4 [five-part evidence starts here](https://github.com/Unjuno/agent-interface/pull/7148#issuecomment-5973381460). Previous32 capsule part1 remains unconfirmed and is not resent.

Fixed unchanged head ed7bb24e45fac16114e1247e00c8ed86cebda5c8; tree2e7d32a21374070a8809a924f2708d4b6eccc88d; reviewbase4e3a5531072be6953c2b4751c6477570c3ded389; historical digest a97eb41e7e67c62aaf6f6c42ced127805c81b0afdc9d81bc4c6a423b5506a7f6. Suspended offer supplies no adoption authority; prior votes transfer zero to a future repair. No author source-ref/main change, native/display/WSLc/shared lease, formal replay, hosted CI, task success or performance qualification follows from this work.
